title: Nesterov Momentum
signature: def nesterov_step(param, grad, buf, lr=0.01, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0.0) -> tuple
hints: Update the buffer exactly as in plain momentum: buf = momentum * buf + g.
Nesterov steps along g + momentum * buf, using the NEW buffer, instead of along buf.
The step g + momentum * new_buf equals the plain momentum step one move further ahead: it adds momentum * new_buf on top of g.
